draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling decoded faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
rationale: Table T1 reports Brisling median latency 41 ms and Talmar 118 ms, so the numbers are correct and Brisling is faster. The hedge "may" is weaker than the evidence supports; the measured medians directly show Brisling lower. No statistical test was reported, so no significance claim is added.
